journey.name: Onboard invalid key: a rejected key keeps the user on the screen
journey.description: A key the API turns away is reported as rejected and nothing is stored, so the user stays on onboarding and can correct it.

actions.action: Verify the onboarding screen is displayed with the heading "chat with me, on your terms"
Verify the button labelled "Enter your key" is disabled
Type "sk-ant-api03-definitely-not-a-real-key" into the "Anthropic API key" field
Verify the button now reads "Validate & continue" and is enabled
Wait until an error about the key being rejected is displayed under the field
Verify the button now reads "Try again"
Verify the onboarding screen is still displayed and the chat list is not
Type one more character into the "Anthropic API key" field
Verify the error message is no longer displayed
